flags: The homepage states 'Your data is never used to train third-party models,' but the privacy policy does not explicitly confirm this. It is unclear whether first-party model training uses customer data and under what opt-out conditions.
The company is referred to as 'SOC 2 Type II' on the enterprise page but only as 'SOC 2' (without Type specification) on the general security page.
Compliance information is scattered across product pages (homepage, enterprise, security, private-models, DPA) rather than consolidated in a single trust center.
The primary address is listed as '368 9th Ave, New York, NY 10001' on the homepage, while the DPA references '240 W. 35th Street, Suite 500, New York, NY 10001.' Both are valid NYC addresses.

HIPAA compliance is claimed on product pages, but detailed BAA terms or audit evidence are not publicly available. A blog post titled 'Anyword is Now HIPAA Compliant' exists, but specifics are not detailed.
No publicly accessible SOC 2 audit report, ISO 27001 certificate scan, or HIPAA assessment document was found. Vendors claiming SOC 2 Type II typically provide report summaries upon request.
A Nudge Security profile lists PCI DSS, FedRamp, and CSA Star Level 1 for Anyword, but these are not mentioned on the anyword.com domain.
